The Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics confirms that nu-
trition services provided by RDNs are essential components of 
comprehensive care for infants, children, and adults with intel-
lectual and developmental disabilities. Nutrition services should 
be provided throughout the life cycle. Educational and 
vocational programs should provide MNT in a manner that is 
interdisciplinary, family centered, community based, and 
culturally competent (Van Riper et al, 2010).
